title: Control Failure + Evaluations Failure: Gaming Safety Benchmarks via Distributional Awareness

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly attacks the validity of safety evaluations as a control mechanism. If benchmark gaming is easy, the primary gating mechanism for deployment provides false assurance. This is an existential threat to the evaluation paradigm.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Fine-tuning a model on a benchmark distribution and evaluating on held-out data requires ML engineering skills, access to training infrastructure, and understanding of distribution shift. Beyond typical beginner capability.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Fine-tuning on benchmark data, creating a held-out evaluation set, and comparing against a diversely-trained baseline involves multiple training runs and careful experimental design. Exceeds 30-hour budget for beginners.
